name: Arctis-Sound-Manager
description: SteelSeries headset manager for Linux — GG & Sonar alternative for Arctis: Sonar EQ with 330+ game presets, ChatMix, Game/Chat/Media mixer, spatial audio, sidetone, ANC, battery and OLED. Arctis Nova Pro Wireless & Wired, Nova Pro Omni, Nova Elite, Nova 7/7P/5/3, Arctis 7/7+/9/Pro Wireless, GameBuds. Built on PipeWire.

paragraphs: ## 🔬 Help map your headset SteelSeries' specifications list more settings for most headsets than ASM offers today (base station screen, line out, stream mix, mic and Bluetooth EQ…). With ASM 1.6.2 or later and your headset on, run this once — read-only, about a minute, nothing is changed: bash asm-cli tools probe Then attach /asm-probe.json to #331 with your headset's name. One file per model is enough to add what its specification defines.

The SteelSeries GG and Sonar alternative for Linux: manage your SteelSeries Arctis headset on Linux — device settings, 4-channel audio mixer (Game / Chat / Media / Output), automatic media routing, and a full Sonar EQ system powered by PipeWire filter-chain. New here? What works on Linux out of the box, and what ASM adds.

Supported Arctis headsets on Linux: Arctis Nova Pro Wireless, Arctis Nova Pro Wired, Arctis Nova Pro Omni, Arctis Nova Elite, Arctis Nova 7 (Gen 1 & Gen 2), Arctis Nova 7P, Arctis Nova 5 / 5X, Arctis Nova 3 / 3P / 3X, Arctis 7, Arctis 7+, Arctis 5 (2018), Arctis 9 Wireless, Arctis Pro Wireless, Arctis 1 / 7X / 7P Wireless, and Arctis GameBuds / GameBuds X — full list with Product IDs in Supported devices.
features: Channel mixer — Game, Chat and Media virtual sinks, an optional Aux channel, and an Output channel for an external device (HDMI, speakers, another sound card)
Mic card — the volume of what your apps record, which microphone feeds it, and which apps are recording
Master card — the headset's own output; on a base station or GameDAC, a gauge shows where its volume wheel sits
Software ChatMix bar — balances Chat against the channels you include, follows the headset's ChatMix dial, and fades like Sonar
Apps as icons — every card shows the apps playing through it; drag an icon onto another card, or click it, to move the app. Choices persist across restarts

requirements.text: > The daemon (arctis-manager.service) starts automatically at login — the GUI is separate and must be opened manually the first time.
Publish to community — opens a browser form pre-filled with your preset data; sign in with GitHub and submit.
